trace.question: Identify the total views on the post 'Computer Game Datasets'. Name the user who posted it last time.
trace.evidence: total views refer to ViewCount; Name the user refers to DisplayName; post 'Computer Game Datasets' refers to Text = 'Computer Game Datasets';

attempts.sql:
SELECT p.ViewCount, u.DisplayName
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE p.Title = 'Computer Game Datasets'

SELECT p.ViewCount, u.DisplayName
FROM posts p
JOIN postHistory ph ON ph.PostId = p.Id
JOIN users u ON ph.UserId = u.Id
WHERE ph.Text = 'Computer Game Datasets'
ORDER BY ph.CreationDate DESC
LIMIT 1

verdicts.text:
The filter uses `posts.Title`, but the external knowledge says the post is identified by `Text = 'Computer Game Datasets'`, which lives in `postHistory`. "Last time" also calls for the most recent revision, so the query needs an ordering and a LIMIT. This fix is inferred from the external knowledge and the question wording, so I haven't confirmed it against the data.

```sql
SELECT p.ViewCount, u.DisplayName
FROM posts p
JOIN postHistory ph ON ph.PostId = p.Id
JOIN users u ON ph.UserId = u.Id
WHERE ph.Text = 'Computer Game Datasets'
ORDER BY ph.CreationDate DESC
LIMIT 1
```
